summary: Full backend + frontend E2E of NEXUS AI on the public preview URL. Backend: 45/45 pytest pass (new regression suite tests/test_nexus_api.py covers 401 auth, two-user isolation, upload 415/409/413, ingestion, documents, search modes, chat SSE, regenerate, feedback, studio, eval, settings, plus the existing test_core/test_pipeline). Frontend: Clerk ticket login, refresh keeps the session, sign-out, protected redirect, Overview, KB (upload validation messages, failed-doc error row, search and status filters, detail chunk inspector, PDF tab, metadata, delete dialog), Chat (streaming, [S#] badges, citation panel, open-and-highlight, insufficient-evidence badge, copy, regenerate, feedback, history, new and delete conversation, suggested questions), Search (keyword results plus error banner for semantic/hybrid), Studio (summary, sentiment doc+text, compare disabled, explain grounded vs general), Research (cached analysis, regenerate ~54s, gap matrix evidence opens panel, Ask in chat prefills), Analytics + Eval Lab (stats, charts, ops table, manual and generated questions, keyword benchmark, history and chart, metric notes), Settings (save persists, overlap validation), Ctrl+K and topbar command launcher, mobile 390px menu. All core flows work. IMPORTANT ENV CHANGE: around 19:25 UTC (after a container restart) OpenAI embeddings started succeeding. Hybrid/semantic search returns 200 with embed_tokens>0, and a new TEST upload was really indexed. So the 'no credits' premise no longer holds.

minor.issue: Regenerate blindly deletes the last 2 messages. If the last turn failed (an error SSE event, so only the user message was saved), regenerate deletes that orphan user message AND the previous successful assistant answer. Reproduced: [user Q1, assistant A1, user Q2(failed)] -> regenerate -> [user Q1, user Q2, assistant A2]. message_count=2 while 3 messages exist. Failed turns also leave orphan user messages without incrementing message_count.

_pct() uses values[int(p*(n-1))]. For small n this returns a low value, so p95 < avg. Examples: research avg 39.05s / p95 24.60s, explain avg 15.9s / p95 14.9s. Use the nearest-rank method (ceil(p*n)-1).

Only status 'processing' is blocked. Deleting while 'queued' (or a reindex race) lets the background ingestion task keep running and insert_many chunks for a document that no longer exists. These orphan chunks are hidden by hydrate() but still counted in overview/analytics chunk counts and in the in-memory index. ingestion.process should check that the doc still exists before storing, or delete should also block 'queued'.

sample_peft.pdf was indexed with the dev fake embedder. Now that real OpenAI embeddings work, semantic/hybrid queries compare real query vectors with fake chunk vectors (top similarity ~0.03-0.05). Hybrid search therefore returns 0 results above the 0.25 threshold. Re-index sample_peft.pdf with real embeddings and consider switching the workspace mode back to hybrid.

rca of the issue: Regenerate bug: routes/chat.py takes the last 2 messages by created_at and deletes them without checking roles. services/chat.py saves the user message before retrieval, and on an error SSE event no assistant message is saved. Repro: keyword-mode Q1 OK -> set mode=semantic (embedding error at the time) -> Q2 in same conversation errors -> set mode back -> regenerate Q2 -> A1 is deleted. Fix: delete by role (trailing assistant plus its user message) or by explicit message id.
